verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is an applicant tracking system, so application-form shaping is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents custom application questions, knockout or disqualifying rules, or EEOC/demographic data collection. Branded job boards, custom fields in reports, and AI Talent Matching tiers are adjacent features and do not show recruiter-configurable forms or knockout logic.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly
